project.name: Network Watch
project.author: MTDI Studio example
project.description: A [[probe]] written in plain Python measures [[TCP connect latency]] to one target every second. MTDI learns the link's normal latency and failure rate, and reports when either departs from it.

rules.text: Latency and failed connects rose together: the path to the target is congested or failing. The target itself being slow looks the same from here.
Connects still succeed but take longer than the learned normal. Local network load, Wi-Fi conditions or a route change can each cause this.

aether.purpose: Shows a pure-software source: any program that prints numbers becomes an MTDI channel through the process adapter.
